entries.name: Meridian Campus — Stacked Final Dungeon
entries.description: Act 3 Meridian final dungeon: four readable eras fracture around a giant Steward core and cable lattice.

entries.name: Halden Market
entries.description: Canvas stalls, dockside produce, shoppers, and cheap machine parts at the hopeful waterfront.

entries.name: Founders Bar
entries.description: A lived-in engineers bar with stools, bottle shelves, prototype screens, and a hand-built Choir halo.

entries.name: Basin Work Camp
entries.description: Survey tents, hardhat crews, a tower crane, and the first exposed datacenter frame.

entries.name: Coastal Highway
entries.description: A cliff road with lane markings, guardrails, salt air, and a wrecked prototype drone.

entries.name: Tolliver Bakery
entries.description: A striped-awning brick bakery anchored by a bread window, round oven, and tall chimney.

entries.name: Undercity Bazaar
entries.description: A crowded black market beneath elevated trains, layered canopies, cables, and Signal booths.

entries.name: Senate Annex
entries.description: A severe hearing room with semicircular desks, witness dais, Commons staffers, and security glass.

entries.name: Meridian Distribution Hub
entries.description: A shuttered warehouse of loading bays, freight, conveyors, forklift, and drone defenses.

entries.name: Migrant Causeway
entries.description: An elevated walkway lined by temporary shelters and controlled by a Warden checkpoint.

entries.name: Glass Quarter
entries.description: Reflective skyscrapers surround a polished public plaza, fountain, benches, and pedestrians.

entries.name: The Stacks
entries.description: Rooftop shacks, rope bridges, ladders, and sailcloth markets rise above a drowned city.

entries.name: Ash Camp
entries.description: Cinder barricades surround a working forge, anvil, watch fire, and stripped armored carrier.

entries.name: Server Graveyard
entries.description: Tilted server racks, torn cables, buried ducts, and a fractured ILO-9 relay fill the dunes.

entries.name: The Fens
entries.description: A broken boardwalk threads through fog, reeds, black bog water, and half-sunken salvage.

entries.name: Tolliver Safehouse
entries.description: The bakery brick shell becomes a guarded refuge when its 2031 fixed point survives.

entries.name: Enclave 7 Commissary
entries.description: A sterile ration hall of scan gates, allocation lanes, service counter, and sealed goods lockers.

entries.name: Kell Village
entries.description: Warm lived-in snow houses and Commons gathering spaces climb below the monastery.

entries.name: Allocation Office
entries.description: The Auditor workplace is a maze of ticket rails, service desks, terminals, and Warden gates.

entries.name: Cooling Perimeter
entries.description: Monumental cooling towers, steam plumes, service pipes, fences, and patrol drones cross a white plain.

entries.name: Strand Memorial
entries.description: A civic plaza organized around Strands monumental head and a curved archive wall.

entries.name: Tolliver Bakery — Saved
entries.description: A repaired roof, full bread window, outdoor table, pennant, and neighbors make the rescued bakery alive.

entries.name: Tolliver Bakery — Burned
entries.description: The chimney and oven survive, but the roof is torn open, the awning hangs burned, and charred beams fill the shop.

entries.name: Tolliver Safehouse — Present
entries.description: The preserved facade now carries barricades, sentries, lamps, bunks, and an open cellar refuge.

entries.name: Tolliver Safehouse — Absent
entries.description: Only the oven, chimney stump, floor slab, and charred bricks remain beneath invasive vines.
entries.condition: Tolliver Bakery was not saved in 2031

entries.name: Kell Village — Armed Resistance
entries.description: The village is fortified with a manned watchtower, Commons banners, barricades, supplies, and a memorial.

entries.name: Kell Village — Let It Fall
entries.description: The village is occupied by a standardized checkpoint, patrol drone spotlight, and boarded houses.

entries.name: Enclave 7 Commissary — Open
entries.description: Retracted gates reveal abundant shelves, shared tables, baskets, and community distribution.

entries.name: Enclave 7 Commissary — Allocated
entries.description: Tall sealed lockers, narrow queue rails, a single dispenser, and red denial lamps enforce rationing.

entries.name: Strand Memorial — Museum
entries.description: The intact head and archive curve become a formal museum with glass cases and guided visitors.

entries.name: Strand Memorial — Ruin
entries.description: The archive wall is breached and the broken head lies among slabs, cables, and weeds.

entries.name: Strand Memorial — Shrine
entries.description: The weathered head becomes a civic shrine surrounded by candles, offerings, flags, and gathered people.

entries.name: World map — 2031
entries.guideSection: Art and style / World map and interface
entries.description: Recognizable topographic map: chapel in the mountains, Meridian campus, domed Capitol, desert server fields and a working port. Flooding consumes Halden in 2148; factories and towers replace earlier infrastructure. Shared geography is an art proposal, not canonical navigation data.
